Level 4 - Advanced 40 min System Design Security Edge

Edge Defense: Bot Detection, WAF Rule Engines and Abuse Signals

After this page you can explain how a big site tells humans from bots without making everyone solve puzzles: risk scores built from network, device and behaviour signals, clustering that spots coordinated campaigns, when to challenge versus silently score, how a WAF rule engine evaluates managed and rate-based rules, how to roll rules out in count mode without blocking real users, and how edge DDoS shielding, WAF and rate limits stack.
